Download **lazy-deck-0.7.0.streamDeckPlugin** below and double-click it. Stream Deck installs or updates the plugin along with its profiles.

- **Tidier action list:** 30 actions instead of over 100. Music, Discord, Steam, Windows, Window, Apps, Websites, Folders, Tools and more each come as one action; pick what the key does in its settings. All 112 keys are still there.
- **New combined actions:** **Status** (internet, Wi-Fi, battery, CPU & memory) and **Timer & countdown** (timer, stopwatch, countdown).
- **White icons** in the action list, as on the Elgato Marketplace.
- Your existing keys and profiles keep working unchanged. Requires Stream Deck 7.6 or newer.
